tests.text: For parting with possession, possession is vested by the tenant in another person by divesting the tenant of physical possession and the right to possession; divestment or abandonment of the right to possession is required.

there must be vesting of possession by the tenant in another person by divesting himself not only of physical possession but also of the right to possession
